Name: TimeLock Deck
Author: Jon Pike
Description: See your TimeLock limits, screen time and what's being counted right now on your Stream Deck. Works with the TimeLock browser extension and TimeLock for Mac.

Actions.Name: Limit
Actions.Tooltip: A ring showing how much of one daily limit is left. Turns orange near the end, red with a lock when locked, green while unlocked. Press to switch between time left and time used.

Actions.Name: Limits Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck +: turn to step through your limits; the bar shows how much is used. Press or tap to switch between time left and used.

Actions.Name: Time Today
Actions.Tooltip: How long you've spent today in one Mac app or on one website. Green while that app is being counted.

Actions.Name: Screen Time Today
Actions.Tooltip: Total time today on your Mac or in the browser. Press to switch.

Actions.Name: Now Counting
Actions.Tooltip: What TimeLock for Mac is counting right now and its time today, plus any media playing in the background. Shows Away or Screen locked when paused.
